articles.title: Does Personalization Break Trust? Open-Set Rejection Calibration Under Few-Shot On-Device Intent Adaptation
articles.abstract: Always-on virtual assistants increasingly personalize on-device to new user-specific commands via few-shot fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA), but this adaptation is evaluated almost exclusively on whether it learns the new commands, not on whether the assistant can still recognize an input that matches none of its intents - the out-of-scope (OOS) rejection problem. We show that naive few-shot LoRA personalization degrades OOS-rejection AUROC (area under the ROC curve) on every one of five public intent-classification benchmarks (mean drop $0.055$--$0.258$, five seeds each), while in-scope accuracy is preserved. A scorer-invariant check shows part of this drop is an artifact of the standard confidence scorer's own miscalibration under adaptation, though a smaller, genuine effect remains under any scorer; we trace it to a measurable shrinkage of the embedding margin around known-intent regions (pooled Spearman rho=0.61$). A deployment-cheap fix is scoring rejection by Mahalanobis distance instead of softmax confidence without extra training/retraining recovers most of the lost quality on 3 of 5 datasets at no accuracy cost, beats two further OOD scoring baselines, and generalizes across shot count, LoRA rank, and a second base encoder. We report honestly where the fix falls short and release all code for reproducibility.
articles.titleCn: 个性化会破坏信任吗？小样本设备端意图适应下的开放集拒绝校准
articles.abstractCn: 始终在线的虚拟助手正通过小样本微调（例如LoRA）在设备上日益个性化地适应新的用户特定指令，但这种适应几乎完全基于它是否学会了新指令的评估，而非评估助手是否仍能识别与其意图不匹配的输入——即范围外（OOS）拒绝问题。我们证明，简单的LoRA小样本个性化会降低五个公开意图分类基准中每一个的OOS拒绝AUROC（ROC曲线下面积）（平均下降0.055--0.258，每个基准使用五个种子），同时保留范围内的准确率。一个评分器不变性检查表明，这种下降的部分原因是标准置信度评分器在适应过程中的自身误校准，尽管在任意评分器下仍存在一个较小、真实的影响；我们将其归因于已知意图区域周围嵌入边界的可测量收缩（合并Spearman rho=0.61）。一个部署成本低的修复方法是使用马氏距离而不是softmax置信度来评分拒绝，无需额外训练/再训练即可在五个数据集中的三个上恢复大部分丢失的质量，且不牺牲准确率，击败了另外两个OOD评分基线，并泛化到样本数量、LoRA秩和第二个基础编码器。我们诚实地报告了修复方法的不足之处，并发布了所有代码以确保可重复性。
